---
title: "Team"
subtitle: "43 people across six research groups"
---

L2IB brings together basic researchers, clinician-scientists and engineers from
Inserm, CNRS, Université Claude Bernard Lyon 1, the ENS de Lyon and the Hospices
Civils de Lyon. Women represent **63 % of the team** and 43 % of its permanent
staff.

Members are listed below under the axis they contribute to. Several people
contribute to two axes and therefore appear twice; **axis leads are marked**.

## Composition

**43 people.**

| Statutory position | Count |
|---|---|
| DR2 Inserm · CRHC CNRS · CRCN Inserm | 1 · 1 · 1 |
| CR HCL · CR IRCCS | 1 · 1 |
| PU-PH / MCU-PH | 9 |
| PH | 2 |
| CCA | 3 |
| ITA / BIATSS (1 IR, 5 IE, 2 AI, 2 TR, 1 AJT) | 11 |
| Post-doctoral fellows | 4 |
| PhD students | 5 |

*Source: HCERES evaluation record, headcount as of 31 December 2024.*

The official roster is also maintained on the
[CIRI website](https://ciri.ens-lyon.fr/teams/lib).
